title: Broker Contract Terms
summary: Broker Veil's standing offer for a discreet extraction of the exchange wounded.
detail_text: Veil's uplink records outline a narrow humanitarian exit: evacuate the safehouse wounded, leave the route vault intact enough for Veil to rebuild, and the broker network will scrub your silhouette from the manifests. The deal is profitable enough to matter and soft enough to anger hardline reclamation crews.
